title: 机械师S2本体与结构性原理共享屏障补弹预算
source_version_match_limit: Installed base resources prove this static template/native configuration. Pinned catalog values are a separately named public source; current server/hotfix values and runtime attachment are not claimed verified.
binding_facts: skchr_mcnist_2._progressSource points to the uniquely hash-bound AbilityEventCounter (_countEvent=7,_expendPerTrigger=1,_ignoreTriggerOnce=1).
_useExtraModeProgress=0 and _extraModeIndex=[]: down-facing extra attack-blackboard mode is not another counter.
mcnist_s_2_mode ON_BUFF_START creates initial owner/token shields without a manual count node.

mcnist_s_2_shield ON_TAKE_DAMAGE exhausted-shield branch performs AOEDamage if caster main buff is active, then reads caster remainingCount, and only if it is positive and main buff is present invokes CharSkillManualTriggerCountEvent and creates this recipient's next barrier.
CharSkillManualTriggerCountEvent.Execute -> caster.skill.currentProgressSource -> ManualTriggerCountEvent. This uses the same caster counter for owner or token shield source.

ManualTriggerCountEvent checks ability.get_isAffecting and dispatches the configured event to counter.OnEvent. The event reaches virtual slot16 DealCountEvent, which adds GetExpendCount=1 when m_notCountNext=false.
Virtual helper 0x180005610 computes vtable offset (slot+0x14)*16; current metadata slot16=DealCountEvent, slot17=GetExpendCount, slot10=OnEvent.
Current SetData resolves trigger_time literal by metadata string index and GetIntOrDefault into m_maxCount, then records m_originalMaxCount.

Counter.OnTick separately sets m_readyToReset when progress is exhausted; CastSkillWithLimitTimes.OnTick resets/finishes through separate ability virtual slots. Zero remaining itself does not determine when the controller runs.
implementation: Explicit aggregate active-break counts now yield shared consumption, replenishments and remaining ammunition with no book/capacity changes.
Existing declared-break/collision window comparison counts consumption from declared breaks, independently of declared target hits.
Initial shields cost zero; final positive-ammo break spends one and still replenishes. All actual clocks/end stay unknown.
The resource projection does not cap declared explosion count by ammo capacity; no event ordering or same-frame end is inferred.

limitations: No live game actions, runtime memory, chats, or private files were used.
XLua/hotfix equality and actual template attachment are not verified.
Shield damage/block conditions, owner/token attack snapshot, first activation/end scheduler, collision/hit times, dynamic capacity creation/deletion, and book poll safety remain unverified.

Conditional resource budgets independently assume main skill buff is present AND the associated skill ability isAffecting count gate is true for the declared breaks, with no reload/capacity events. Buff presence does not prove the ability gate.
Budget counters do not assert actual per-recipient replenishment allocation at unknown same-frame ordering or actual skill completion.
